title: CHARUSAT National Tech Expo 2026
description: Annual university exhibition showcasing AI models, IoT hardware prototypes, embedded robotics, and software engineering capstones.

title: DevForge 36-Hour Hackathon
description: Intensive team hackathon challenging students to build full-stack web and mobile applications solving community and campus challenges.

title: Annual Inter-College Sports Meet: Spoural
description: Competitive inter-department tournament featuring cricket, football, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, and track events.

title: International Conference on Cloud & DevOps
description: Keynote lectures by cloud architects and industry leaders on microservices, Kubernetes orchestration, and continuous deployment pipelines.

title: Full-Stack Web Development Workshop
description: Hands-on masterclass covering modern JavaScript ES6+, PHP 8 backend REST APIs, MySQL PDO prepared statements, and async Fetch integrations.

title: Spoural Cultural Night & Folk Dance Fest
description: A vibrant celebration of regional folk traditions, classical music, theatrical drama, and western group dance performances.

title: Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking Bootcamp
description: Practical exploration of vulnerability assessment, SQL injection mitigation, network packet analysis with Wireshark, and defensive cryptography.

title: Machine Learning in Healthcare Symposium
description: Insights into deep learning algorithms for medical imaging diagnosis, genomic sequencing, and predictive electronic health records.

title: Annual Robotics Battle: RoboWar 2026
description: Fast-paced combat robotics competition testing RC chassis strength, pneumatic weapons, obstacle evasion, and tactical maneuvering.

title: Alumni Career Mentorship & Placement Talk
description: CHARUSAT alumni working in Fortune 500 tech companies share strategies for technical interviews, DSA preparation, and resume building.

title: Campus Photography & Short Film Showcase
description: Exhibition of student cinematography, documentary shorts, architectural campus photography, and digital art portfolios.

title: IoT & Smart Home Automation Hands-on
description: Assemble ESP32 and Raspberry Pi sensor nodes, configure MQTT communication brokers, and control household appliances via a cloud dashboard.

title: Inter-Department Chess Championship
description: FIDE-rated rapid and blitz tournament open to undergraduate and postgraduate students from all engineering institutes.

title: Android & Flutter App Development Camp
description: Cross-platform mobile application development using Dart and Flutter, integrating Firebase authentication and real-time Firestore database.

title: Research Paper Writing & LaTeX Masterclass
description: Guidance on literature reviews, IEEE conference manuscript formatting using LaTeX, bibliography management with BibTeX, and publication ethics.

title: Campus Green Energy & Sustainability Forum
description: Panel discussions exploring campus solar micro-grids, rainwater harvesting innovations, zero-carbon engineering, and environmental stewardship.
